description: Suppresses the most prominent partials inside a frequency band, but only BETWEEN scheduled time pairs: the timeslots datafile lists start/end pairs, and within each slot the chancnt loudest channels between lofrq and hifrq are suppressed. The time-gated complement of blur suppress (which kills the N loudest everywhere, always). Timeslot validation is strict with verbatim refusals: pairs closer than one frame 'ERROR: Times (0.800000 & 0.200000) in file <name> less than 1 sampleframe (0.002902 secs) apart.' (also catches reversed pairs); odd counts 'ERROR: Data not paired correctly in file <name>'. Static duration (2.0230 / 1.5209); deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Rhythmic spectral ducking: schedule slots and the sound's dominant components vanish on cue, leaving the residue - breath, noise floor, weaker partials - suddenly exposed. Used per-beat it makes a spectral sidechain/gate pattern cut from the sound's own strongest material; used structurally (one long slot) it hollows out a passage's core while the frame stays. Band-limit the suppression to sculpt where the bite happens: lofrq/hifrq around the fundamental region removes the root but keeps the shimmer; a high band removes brilliance in pulses. chancnt scales the depth per slot (a handful of channels = subtle dimming; dozens = spectral silhouette). Times are plain text - generate slot grids programmatically for tempo-locked patterns.

timeslots.description: Text file of paired times 'start end' (seconds), one pair per line, each pair at least one analysis frame apart and in order (write with write_data_file()). Refusals verbatim: reversed/too-close pairs quote both times and the frame threshold; an odd number of values refuses 'Data not paired correctly in file <name>'.

lofrq.description: Low frequency limit of the band where partials are suppressed. CDP-enforced 0 to nyquist ('-5' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[2] Value (-5.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 22050.000000)'). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' - note CDP numbers the brk slot differently from the range slot).

hifrq.description: High frequency limit of the suppression band ('30000' refused verbatim, Parameter[3], same 0-22050 range).

chancnt.description: Number of most-prominent channels in the band to suppress per window. CDP-enforced 1 to the analysis channel count ('0'/'2000' refused verbatim quoting '(1.000000 to 513.000000)').

examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('slots.txt', '0.2 0.8\n1.2 1.8') - the 4 loudest mid-band channels vanish during each slot.

examples.description: Hollow out a whole passage's core.
examples.expected_use: write_data_file('whole.txt', '0.0 2.0') - deep suppression of the low-mid dominants throughout.

known_issues: Timeslot pairs must be ordered and at least one analysis frame apart - reversed pairs are refused with the same verbatim message as too-close pairs (both times quoted).
No breakpoint-capable parameters; the temporal shaping lives entirely in the timeslots file.
Suppression targets the LOUDEST channels in the band per window (like blur suppress / hilite trace's complement) - which partials die can change window to window on evolving material.
wav input refused ('ERROR: File <name> is not of correct type'); engine auto-PVOCs.
Deterministic (1.3 s-apart runs byte-identical in the data chunk).
